summary_plain_english: The 'description' field changed type from string to array on /api/v1/items/ affecting 7 files.
patch_description: 7 files updated to reflect field type change for 'description' on POST /api/v1/items/ (and related endpoints): changed from string | null to Array<string> | null in ItemCreate, ItemPublic, and ItemUpdate type definitions in both types.gen.ts files; updated Zod schemas from z.string() to z.array(z.string()), default values from '' to [], and Input rendering to join/split array values in AddItem.tsx and EditItem.tsx; fixed columns.tsx description cell to use array length check and join for display; updated randomItemDescription() in random.ts to return a string array; and updated items.spec.ts to call .join(', ') before filling the Description field.
verify_log: tsc --noEmit: 0 errors (type contract verified). npm run build: vite build succeeded in 3.93s, production bundle compiled cleanly.
